'''Robert Allen Plane''' (1927 – August 6, 2018) was an American retired chemistry professor and college administrator. He served as [[Provost (education)|Provost]] of [[Cornell University]] from 1969 to 1973 and president and chief executive officer of [[Clarkson University]] from 1974 until 1985.<ref>[https://web.archive.org/web/20060629200318/http://www.cornell.edu/provost/history.cfm Cornell University - Office of the Provost - History of Cornell's Provosts<!-- Bot generated title -->]</ref> From 1991 to 1995, he was president of [[Wells College]].<ref>[http://www.wells.edu/whatsnew/wnspch27.htm Wells College Speeches<!-- Bot generated title -->] {{webarchive |url=https://web.archive.org/web/20110723165949/http://www.wells.edu/whatsnew/wnspch27.htm |date=July 23, 2011 }}</ref>

Plane graduated from Evansville College (now called [[University of Evansville]]) in Indiana in 1948 with a bachelor's degree, and from the [[University of Chicago]] in 1951 with a doctorate.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://provost.cornell.edu/about/history-of-cornells-provosts/|title=History of Cornell's Provosts &#124; Office of the Provost}}</ref>

==Books==
*''Chemistry'' by Michell J. Sienko and Robert A. Plane (Hardcover - Jun 1974)
*''Elements of Inorganic Chemistry'' (The Physical inorganic chemistry series) by Robert A Plane (1965)
*''The Quality of Life Nineteen Essays of Cornell Faculty'' by Stuart M., Jr., James H. Clancy, et al.; Brady, Hans A., Robert A. Plane, Urie Bronfenbrenner, Allan P. Sindler, et al. Brown (Hardcover - 1968)
*''Wine Acidity: Taste, Measurement, Control'' (American Wine Society manual) by Robert A Plane (1983)
